notes.title: Update for version 1.3 (two new angels)
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
· Azrael's Mischief: In the 14th year, Azrael will appear in the big map, messing with players
· New plot: Gabriel, Raphael just feel the plot

[b]New role:[/b]
· Gabriel the Wise Angel: Fifteenth year, appeared in the Angel Tavern
· Healing Angel Raphael: Sixteenth year, appeared at the Angel Tavern

[b]Optimize the experience:[/b]
· Fixed a situation where clicking the console and Travel buttons in advance would cause the game to get stuck before each round starts
· In the judgment, the choice to go to heaven changed from giving no resources to giving one-way resources

[b]New achievements:[/b]
· Drink achievements:Get Gabriel drunk，Get Gabriel drunk，Get Rafael drunk
· Plot achievements: Gabriel 4 heart affection achievement, Raphael 4 heart affection achievement

notes.title: Update for version 1.2 (three new characters, two angels, one special character)
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
· Daily News system: You can check what happened to special NPCS after they returned to reality
· New plot: Sariel, Su, Azrael just feel the plot

[b]New role:[/b]
· The Fallen Angel Sariel: In the twelfth year, he appears at the Angel Tavern
· Angel of Death Azrael: In the 13th year, at the Angel Tavern
· Game author · Su: will be randomly refreshed on the right side of each minimap

[b]Optimize the experience:[/b]
· Added missing strong characters: Mammon 1-2 hearts, Asmodeus 1 heart, Beelzebub 1 heart, Beelphegor 1 heart
· After the seventh round of Hell, the number of events triggered has changed from one to two
· After drinking with angels every night, the maximum amount of alcohol will be increased and the probability of getting drunk will be reduced
· Added a guarantee button for drawing purple card in the card interface
· Enrich the content of the chat

[b]New achievements:[/b]
· Drink achievements: Drink Azrael, drink Sariel, drink Azrael (special costume), drink Sariel (special costume)
· Plot achievements: Sariel 4 heart achievements, Azrael 4 heart achievements, Su 4 heart achievements
· Entertainment achievement: Elbow hit Su

notes.title: Mid-Autumn Festival is coming, update version!
notes.content:
[b]New Features & Gameplay:[/b]
· New resource: Stars, props used to cultivate angel goodwill
· Added a special day: Dance Day, you can dance with the devil, get a lot of stars
· Uriel's Mischief: After 11 years in Hell, Uriel will have the probability to refresh the map and make mischief, which can repel her and obtain stars
· Israfil's store: Used to buy new resources · Stars, sell new costumes for angels, and upgrade rewards for chatting, dating, and playing cards with girls
· New plot: Uriel and Israphael's plot
· New interactive drinking mode: You can drink and interact with angels at night

[b]New role:[/b]
·Archangel Israfil: an angel merchant who sells stars and costumes
· Archangel Uriel: The angel who watches over Hell

[b]Optimize the experience:[/b]
· When Abyss is defeated and full of affection, she will return to her good sister form
· Trial acceleration button to adjust position
· Increased the ability to get sound effects when a mission is achieved
· More trial words
· The Lord of Heaven in the beginning animation strengthens the feminine character

[b]Fix bugs:[/b]
· Asmontis likes plot typos
· Correcting typos in the dating process
· Modify the stage description of playing cards

[b]New achievements:[/b]
· PROM achievement: Perfect dance *6, dance failure
· Drinking Achievements: Drunk Uriel, drunk Israel, drunk Uriel (special costume), drunk Israel (special costume)
· Plot achievements: Israphael 4 heart achievements, Uriel 4 heart achievements
· Draw card achievement: Draw the abyss, draw the Lord of Heaven, draw the lost self

notes.title: Demo version 1.0.1 Optimization and subsequent updates
notes.content:

2.Female Devil describes UI adjustment and modification, fixed the female devil proposal probability display error.

4.Added a guide button for action mode, plus additional text prompts.
